title: Trajectory radius
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for the radius of the particle's circular path as r = 2a.

title: Entry velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for the particle's entry velocity as v = 2kBa.

title: Motion time from P to Q
description: Essential: Correctly states the final answer for the transit time as t = π/(3kB).

title: Geometry of exit condition
description: Important: Applies geometry (e.g., 30-60-90 triangles) to relate the trajectory radius r, the offset a, and the 60° exit angle.

title: Lorentz force centripetal condition
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law with the magnetic Lorentz force providing centripetal acceleration: qvB = mv²/r.

title: Period in magnetic field
description: Important: Recognizes and uses the formula for the period of circular motion in a uniform magnetic field: T = 2πm/(qB) = 2π/(kB).

title: Fraction of period traveled
description: Important: Correctly identifies the angular displacement from P to Q as 60° and relates the travel time to the period via t = (60°/360°) * T.

title: Charge-to-mass ratio usage
description: Optional: Explicitly substitutes k = q/m to express final answers in terms of the given parameter k.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Makes an error in the sign/direction of the velocity or force, or misinterprets the geometry (e.g., using the wrong angle).

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Presents an answer with incorrect or inconsistent units, or omits units where they are implied.
